steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.cooler.push({species:'king',weight:18.2,length:95,value:218,legend:null,name:'King Salmon'}); g.state.trophies.push({species:'caribou',name:'Caribou',weight:130,value:420}); const it=g.props.interactions.find(i=>i.id==='post'); g.player.place(it.x,it.z,0); return 'at post'})()

(()=>{const b=document.getElementById('sell-all'); if(!b) return 'no sell button, open='+__rhf.game.screens.current; b.click(); const g=__rhf.game; return 'money '+g.state.money+' cooler '+g.state.cooler.length+' challenges '+Object.keys(g.state.challenges).join(',')})()

(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-act=buy-engine]')][0]; b.click(); const p=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-act=buy-paint]')][1]; p.click(); const g=__rhf.game; return 'engine '+g.state.gear.engine+' paint '+g.state.gear.paint+' money '+g.state.money})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const p=g.world.place('falls'); return 'car near falls '+Math.hypot(g.hotrod.pos.x-p.x,g.hotrod.pos.z-p.z).toFixed(0)+' time '+g.env.time.toFixed(2)})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const it=g.props.interactions.find(i=>i.id==='cabin'); g.player.place(it.x,it.z,0); g.env.setTime(22.5); return 'at cabin'})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const ia=g.interaction; if(!ia) return 'no ia'; ia.act(); return 'slept via '+ia.label})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.save(); const raw=localStorage.getItem('rubenHotrodFishing.save.v1'); const d=JSON.parse(raw); return 'saved money '+d.money+' engine '+d.gear.engine+' day '+d.day})()
(()=>{__rhf.start(true); const g=__rhf.game; return 'continued money '+g.state.money+' paint '+g.state.gear.paint+' day '+g.env.day})()
(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; return 'after KO health '+g.player.health+' money '+g.state.money+' cooler '+g.state.cooler.length})()
